versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-extract-video-text.
- Transcribes video/audio content into clean, reusable text, removing filler words, errors, and repetition.
- Supports custom prompt-based outputs for summaries, rewrites (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, etc.), highlight extraction, scripts, translations, and more.
- Only processes completed (non-live) videos from public URLs or local files; does not support encrypted or members-only videos.
- Requires configuration of GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN before use; no processing or charges with missing/invalid token.
- Clear error handling, usage examples, and detailed FAQ included for user guidance.
